admission.reviewer: deterministic evidence checks; no human or LLM review claimed
admission.scope: conditional source-specific construction input only; no finished memory, retrieval, injection or effectiveness proof

costs: all four count/mass/height/envelope secondary directions and applicability; full metrics and latency/cost/area-load ledger retained

entrypoints.evaluate: evaluate(reference, alternative, *, rule_version); v1 receives original receipts and returns old tuple; v2 receives normalized views and returns evaluation dict
entrypoints.metric_view: metric_view(original_receipt, private_task, frozen_data_identity); private full task only for denominator/evaluation; never retrieval/model input

identity: plan and source digest anchor new analysis; original manifest, complete v1 record and original receipt digests remain separate
missing_policy: invalid primary/denominator/nonfinite; unavailable nonempty compactness invalidates that layer; higher loading win with gap cannot pass material review
review_scope: deterministic evidence review; facts only, no human/LLM review or generated experience card claim

rule.compactness: height lower, envelope higher; both empty NOT_APPLICABLE; missing nonempty metrics invalidate compactness layer and reject experience
rule.hierarchy: first unequal stable completion or volume decides; otherwise count/mass Pareto; only equal loading permits height/envelope Pareto
rule.neutral: registered metric equivalence only; not action, box-set or layout identity
